admission.justification: The obligation's realizations in more than one file are what its statement binds together.

applicability: The Knowledge view whenever it is selected in the dashboard.
conditions: The Knowledge view is `fullBleed` and kept mounted while another view is shown.
The reader holds its address in the URL hash, so the shell keeps no document state.
exclusions: The four retained pages outside the product bar (Engine Room, Memory, Topology, Hangar).
The File Viewer layout the Knowledge page reuses, which this obligation does not change.
statement: Knowledge occupies the full dashboard width and retains its document and reading position across tab switches.
